facts.fact: The ITU reports that Mozambique's National Digital Transformation Strategy (ENTD) 2027-2036, launched by the government in February 2026 and refined through regional validation in May 2026, awaits approval by the Council of Ministers.
The ITU says the ENTD covers 2027-2036, with measurable checkpoints and 14 flagship commitments to 2031.

Citizen-centred digital services are a goal only; no service online stated.
